[[Custo's Hornbow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] dropped by [[Colonel Custo]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Dejarin Estate]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]] 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15%
:[[Armor rating|Armor]] -10 (while [[attacking]])
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
:[[Marksmanship]] +1 (20% chance while using [[skill]]s)

==Skin== 
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Bladed Recurve Bow]] [[dye]]d white.

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance and [[armor calculation#Categories|armor category]] of the inscription, it is possible to create a replica for this item with the same stats. Inscriptions on replicas affect core armor rather than bonus armor and are not limited by the bonus armor cap.
*One of the following [[hornbow]]s:
**[[Stoneshard Hornbow]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Hornbow]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Hornbow]] from collector [[Zaishen Martial Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Hornbow]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Hornbow of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Hornbow]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Hornbow]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Hornbow]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Hornbow]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Hornbow]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Hornbow]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Sundering]] [[Bow String]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Bow Grip]] [[of Attribute|of Marksmanship]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|To the Pain!]]" inscription

==Unique counterpart==
[[Benwah's Recurve Bow]] has stats identical to this item; however, it is a different bow class.
